dispositions.topic_text: Whether required tests must cover every forbidden date form
dispositions.what: the INV-17 witness covers a date ending in Z and in +HH:MM and -HH:MM as old

dispositions.topic_text: Which no-old-date cases the passing test must cover
dispositions.what: the INV-17 witness passes a project whose photo_date values all carry no Z and no offset, and an empty photo list

dispositions.topic_text: Which observable effects must prove detection and stopping
dispositions.what: the INV-17 witness shows the detection that A11 rule 2 stops on; the stop itself is the calling flow's (A11 rule 4)
